mapper.sql: d.required_quantity - d.picked_quantity + CASE WHEN t.rework_material_plan_id IS NULL THEN d.returned_quantity ELSE 0 END

SELECT d.*, AS remaining_quantity, CASE d.pick_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待领料' WHEN 'PICKING' THEN '领料中' WHEN 'PICKED' THEN '已领料' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '完成' ELSE d.pick_status END AS pick_status_name, s.balance AS stock_quantity, s.balance < () AS is_stock_shortage, CASE WHEN s.balance IS NOT NULL AND d.required_quantity IS NOT NULL AND d.picked_quantity IS NOT NULL AND d.returned_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(0, - s.balance) END AS shortage_quantity FROM mes_material_list_detail d JOIN mes_material_list h ON h.id = d.material_list_id AND h.task_id = d.task_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND h.factory_code = d.factory_code AND h.del_flag = '0' JOIN mes_task t ON t.id = h.task_id AND t.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND t.factory_code = h.factory_code AND t.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(d.unit), '') IS NULL OR bool_or(stock.num IS NULL OR stock.num < 0 OR (stock.num <> 0 AND stock.mat_unit IS DISTINCT FROM d.unit)) THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(sum(stock.num), 0) END AS balance FROM mes_warehouse_live_stock stock WHERE stock.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND stock.factory_code = d.factory_code AND stock.mat_code = d.material_code AND stock.del_flag = '0' ) s ON true WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.factory_code = #{factoryCode}

AND d.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY d.create_time, d.id

update.foreach: UPDATE mes_material_list_detail SET picked_quantity = picked_quantity + #{detail.pickedQuantity}, actual_quantity = picked_quantity - returned_quantity, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{detail.id}

UPDATE mes_material_list_detail SET returned_quantity = returned_quantity + #{detail.returnedQuantity}, actual_quantity = picked_quantity - returned_quantity, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{detail.id}
